data.title: Women's monthly bus pass now priced at 15 days

slides.head: Women's monthly bus pass now priced at 15 days
What happened
slides.body: Women pay a 15-day fare (was 20) including tolls; for others, tolls are counted for 20 days instead of 25, and the distance limit on passes is gone.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: TGSRTC says the move aims to boost ridership and make daily bus travel cheaper for students, employees and regular commuters.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: A new combi-ticket lets pass holders take a higher-category bus for Rs 20 extra per trip.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: The scheme starts today; Sunday free rides first apply on November 15. Ask: Will TGSRTC publish ridership numbers after the new pass rules?

slides.head: HC to govt: ensure water for all, file drought affidavit by Dec 9
What happened
slides.body: A bench of Acting Chief Justice P Sam Koshy and Justice Suddala Chalapathi Rao said the situation 'was not man-made and the govt cannot be blamed', but asked for the measures taken, per TOI.

slides.body: Telangana got 630.1 mm of rain from June 1 to Oct 31 against a normal 833.1 mm, a 24% deficit, per the petitioners.

slides.body: Telangana needs about 409 tmc of drinking water; about 200 tmc is available, petitioners said.

slides.head: What to watch
